# robust (Huber) regression
import statsmodels.api as sm
for e in exposures:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'yield_kg']).copy()
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['farm']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[e]=d[e]
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    r = sm.RLM(d['yield_kg'], X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# residualize soil_ph and yield on farm, then look
d = df.dropna(subset=['soil_ph','yield_kg']).copy()
m1 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ C(farm)', data=d).fit()
m2 = smf.ols('soil_ph ~ C(farm)', data=d).fit()
res_y = m1.resid; res_x = m2.resid
print(np.corrcoef(res_x, res_y)[0,1])
# partial regression
import statsmodels.api as sm
X = sm.add_constant(res_x)
r = sm.OLS(res_y, X).fit()
print(r.summary())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# soil_ph: check with/without outliers, and controlling for all others
m=smf.ols('yield_kg ~ soil_ph + C(farm)',data=df).fit()
print("base", m.params['soil_ph'], m.pvalues['soil_ph'])
# winsorize yield
d=df.dropna(subset=['soil_ph','yield_kg']).copy()
lo,hi=d['yield_kg'].quantile([0.01,0.99])
d['yw']=d['yield_kg'].clip(lo,hi)
m2=smf.ols('yw ~ soil_ph + C(farm)',data=d).fit()
print("winsor", m2.params['soil_ph'], m2.pvalues['soil_ph'])
# add all other exposures
exposures = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
m3=smf.ols('yield_kg ~ soil_ph + '+' + '.join(exposures)+' + C(farm)',data=df).fit()
print("full", m3.params['soil_ph'], m3.pvalues['soil_ph'])

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

exposures = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']

import statsmodels.api as sm
for e in exposures:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'yield_kg']).copy()
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['farm']], drop_first=True).astype(float)

    X = sm.add_constant(X)

    print(f"{e:18s} coef={r.params[e]:+.4f} p={r.pvalues[e]:.4f}")
"}

df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

m2 = smf.ols('soil_ph ~ C(farm)', data=d).fit()

# partial regression
import statsmodels.api as sm

r = sm.OLS(res_y, X).fit()
print(r.summary())
"}
